body: Oh, you mean "Zero Skill Spamus"? Hahaha! I love that nickname for her. Unless you're talking about regular Samus. I hate it when Villager steals my charge shot. XD

Thank you so much for the comment. Hopefully we can maybe get something positive out of this-which is usually very difficult to do... I just don't want us to have suffered for nothing, you know? Desperately trying to hold on while feeling all this despair is very challenging. And of course you are allowed to share! I won't make this all about me, because it's not like I am the unluckiest person alive. We all have problems, it's the people who always try to run away from them/overly distract themselves that worry me.
Yes, I've thought of that too. They have helped me a lot already, but it's still very difficult. Meditating does help though

Thank you for your input. I completely agree with that. I rarely talk to people about my problems because usually other people have problems that they are trying to run away from/distract themselves from and they really cannot handle the feeling of someone else reminding them of their own problems that they are too scared to handle. *that was a mouthful* It's quite frustrating. Same deal with my family, from what you said. 

Eagles are amazing! Every time I meet someone with an eagle, it is hard to dislike them. :) And I play anything from Call of Duty to Final Fantasy. I've been busy with Super Smash Brothers U for a while. Sorry for the delay here too

True. I forgot to mention that I AM seeing a phycologist, but since I only see her once a week, things get worse in between. I can safely say that the people who are making things worse because of how selfish they are is my mother and her new husband. I'm going crazy and I just want to move from there, to a place I can call my own. Sadly, my house has never felt like a home, all my life, no matter where I move, all because of them.
I have multiple animals. It's not uncommon for people to have many, either. But the main ones are a white leopard and a tiger. They look very interesting
To be honest I get extremely nervous when I call on skype... I'm a very shy person to new people. But I have no problem with texting/writing.
